dz: 八十年战争:"明斯特和奥斯纳布吕克条约"签署,结束了荷兰和西班牙的冲突.
de: Eighty Years' War: The Treaty of Münster and Osnabrück is signed, ending the conflict between the Netherlands and Spain.

dz: 英格兰布里斯托尔海峡和塞弗恩埃斯图里海岸一带估计有200平方英里(51,800公顷)被大洪水所摧毁,估计造成2000人死亡.
de: An estimated 200 square miles (51,800 ha) along the coasts of the Bristol Channel and Severn Estuary in England are destroyed by massive flooding, resulting in an estimated 2,000 deaths.

t: 瓦雷鲁国王发现了汉萨瓦底王国,并宣布从帕干王国独立.
te: King Wareru founds the Hanthawaddy kingdom, and proclaims independence from the Pagan Kingdom.
dz: 瓦雷鲁国王发现了汉萨瓦底王国,并宣布从帕干王国独立.
de: King Wareru founds the Hanthawaddy kingdom, and proclaims independence from the Pagan Kingdom.

te: Poland and the Holy Roman Empire conclude the Peace of Bautzen.
dz: 波兰和神圣罗马帝国缔结"鲍岑和平".
